name: smwsprites-poison-mushroom
title: Poison Mushroom
description:
This is the poison mushroom from the original Super Mario Bros., now as a regular custom sprite. It can be placed in the level or spawned from a block.

(Rykon-V73): Added .json file for the sprite.

(AmperSam): Updated with an extra bit check, which if enabled the mushroom kills the player, but otherwise just hurts.
